words: DB-f-2202 adds, by pure insertion in locals.tf (zero base lines removed or changed, added lines ASCII, LF endings kept): the table constant irpt_rg_gold_table_transaction = "account_transaction" beside the other table constants, the prefix irpt_rg_gold_transaction_prefix built from the firm and that constant beside irpt_rg_gold_filled_prefix, and ONE element as the LAST element of irpt_rg_gold_write_arns. The write list goes from 6 elements to 7. The single PutObject statement in iam.tf (sid WriteTheFiveGoldPrefixesOnly, kept) takes that list, so the transaction prefix becomes writable and nothing else changes. The read prefixes, the read arns and the list pattern are unchanged and do not name the transaction prefix, because the handler writes the table but does not list or read it. iam.tf, lambda.tf, main.tf and schedule.tf are byte-identical to the base (sha256, checker DBF136-2-AC1). NOT PROVEN: no terraform plan was run, nothing was applied, no AWS call was made, and no write to the prefix was exercised; the plan gate and the first write belong to the applier under a later signed pair.
